item.description: ### Fixed - **Cursor's parallel subagents no longer leave phantom sessions behind.** When Cursor splits work across several agents at once, each one runs as a session in its own right and simply stops when it's done — it never reports finishing. So a single delegation left four or five rows spinning in your list long after the work was over. Those now settle within about a minute and a half. - **No more late "finished" notifications for work that already ended.** When Perch gives up waiting on a Cursor session that went quiet, that's Perch losing track — not the agent finishing — and it no longer announces it as a completion. One parallel delegation would previously have sent you four.
